articles.title: Former NYSE president says stock issuers hold the key to tokenization as Bullish builds its platform
articles.snippet: Stacey Cunningham, who recently joined digital asset platform Bullish as President, sees the company’s planned Equiniti acquisition and focus on stock issuers as key to its tokenization ambitions.

articles.title: U.S. CPI rose stronger than expected 0.4% in October; core rate rose 0.3%
articles.snippet: A December rate hike appears completely assured, with Fed Governor Chris Waller suggesting even a 50-basis-point move could be appropriate.

articles.title: Robinhood backs tokenization of its stock on OKX–ICE platform even as most companies opt out
articles.snippet: The brokerage firm said it would rather help build tokenized markets than sit on the sidelines, following a wave of early corporate pushback to the Intercontinental Exchange and OKX joint venture.

articles.title: Google’s AI chip push adds more pressure on Nvidia
articles.snippet: Google’s specialised AI chips threaten greater competition as Nvidia faces a leadership investigation.

articles.title: Can crypto trust firms compete with banks in US derivatives settlements?
articles.snippet: Crypto custodians are moving into a market handling billions in daily settlements, but regulatory relief and a shift in congressional control leave questions over their long-term role.
